title: My Cats love the box it came with ...
text:
The cats loved everything that came, but after a day it was with the pile of other toys they have.
They claim all items are checked for non toxic and pet safe which is a plus.
Yes, other reviews said you can get similar toys from the dollar store, but is it really safe for pets? Haven't heard on a major recall on cats toys lately, so I guess that statement maybe true.
Toys are high end quality, but the cats don't know that. They will play with a ball of paper the same way.
This is a nice gift, but monthly, I don't know, bi monthly, no. Yearly? Hmmmm, is the dollar store open?
label: neutral
